schema: embodic equation registry draft v0 (Phase 1, 2026-10-04) - source: equation_specification_draft.md
notes: status = Phase 1 evidence status of the equation; implementation status starts as 'not tested' until its tests pass in CI (ADR-0003 item 5)
gate_verdict 'replace' for EQ-04 and EQ-21 means: no Xcoil implementation exists, implement new from the specification
result status = weakest of equation status, implementation status, status of every used input (defaults = assumption), validity cap (violation = unresolved)
reference values are computed by Agent 2 (scripts in checks/); none is a measurement

equations.name: Pole pitch, coil pitch, electrical angle
equations.formula: tau_p(r) = pi*r/p; theta_p = pi/p; theta_cp = 2*pi/Q; theta_e = p*theta
equations.source_notes: D08 eq. 3.2 p.31; coil pitch by geometry (D08 eq. 3.27 prints pi/p, valid only for Q = 2p)

equations.name: Turn-count limits of a trapezoidal spiral coil (radial bound + constructive loop criterion)
equations.formula: w_d = w + s; N_c < 0.5*((r_o - r_i)/w_d + 1) (D08 3.24); loop i (d_i = (i+1/2)*w_d) is trapezoidal iff d_i < (r_i + i*w_d)*sin(theta_cp/2), triangular iff not trapezoidal and d_i/sin(theta_cp/2) < r_o - i*w_d; printed D08 3.25-3.26 kept as cross-check

variables.meaning: centre-line radius of the outer end-turn of loop 0
centre-line radius of the inner end-turn of loop 0

equations.source_notes: D08 p.33 eq. 3.5, p.43 eq. 3.24-3.26; loop criterion derived from D08 eq. 3.28-3.29 (Agent 2); printed 3.25-3.26 mis-split trapezoidal/triangular loops

tolerance.value: exact integer (loop criterion); printed 3.25-3.26 may differ by 1; generator +/-1 turn
tolerance.basis: centre-via eye and fillets not in the closed form

dominant_assumptions: trace width w and clearance s (fabricator capability)

reference_case.source: D08 Table 4.5 p.54 / Table 4.6 p.57 (3 loops); checks/eq02_eq03_reference.py

equations.name: Loop geometry and track length (closed-form cross-check)
equations.formula: phi_in,i = asin(d_i/(r_i + i*w_d)); phi_out,i = asin(d_i/(r_o - i*w_d)); beta = theta_cp/2 - phi; L_out,i = 2*(r_o - i*w_d)*beta_out,i; L_in,i = 2*(r_i + i*w_d)*beta_in,i (0 if beta_in,i <= 0); L_s,i = d_i/tan(phi_out,i) - d_i/tan(phi_in,i) (phi_in -> theta_cp/2 if triangular); L_i = L_out,i + L_in,i + 2*L_s,i; L = sum L_i
equations.source_notes: D08 p.44-45 eq. 3.27-3.36 with corrections: theta_cs -> 2*pi/Q; one pair of sides per loop (printed 3.34 x 3.36 doubles them)

tolerance.value: 1e-3 mm vs closed form; +/-6 % closed form vs generated spiral
tolerance.basis: spiral steps one pitch per turn and ends at a centre via (C4: -3.7 % / -5.5 %)

dominant_assumptions: corner radius (closed form uses sharp corners)

equations.name: Pole-arc ratio of rectangular block magnets
equations.formula: tau_M(r) = 2*asin(w_PM/(2r))*r; alpha_p(r) = 2*p*asin(w_PM/(2r))/pi
equations.source_notes: D08 p.31 eq. 3.3; no Xcoil implementation (constant alpha_p only) -> new implementation

equations.name: Air-gap field, 2-D harmonic model at each radius
equations.formula: K_n = (4*B_r/(n*pi))*sin(n*pi*alpha_p/2); u = n*p/r; B_z,n = K_n*cosh(u*(G - z))/(cosh(u*G) + mu_r*coth(u*l_m)*sinh(u*G)); B_t,n = K_n*sinh(u*(G - z))/(same); G = (t_s + 2g)/2 double rotor, t_s + 2g single + yoke, infinity single open; odd n only
equations.source_notes: D08 eq. 3.1 p.31 (identical for mu_r = 1); D09 eq. 1 p.4 (form); magnet data Arnold (EV-54/55); mu_r not found (G23); Bumby & Martin not accessed (EV-63/G8); closed form derived by Agent 2

tolerance.value: +/-5 % on B1 at mid-radius vs 3-D FEA; not valid within ~1 gap of the radial magnet ends
tolerance.basis: D09 p.4 reports <1 % for a comparable model at mean radius; add mu_r/B_r(T) uncertainty and saturation (D08 p.112); D09 Fig. 7 edge drop ~40 %

additional_cases.source: D09 Table 3 p.4 rotor vs Fig. 7 FEA (figure reading)

equations.name: Back-EMF and flux linkage of a copper path
equations.formula: e(t) = omega_m * sum_seg r_m*B_z(r_m, theta_m - theta_r, z_L)*dr; Ke_n = |sum_seg B_z,n(r_m, z_L)*r_m*dr*exp(-j*n*p*theta_m)| (T*mm^2 x 1e-6 = V*s/rad); loop form psi = integral B_z dA, E = -(dpsi/dtheta_m)*omega_m

variables.meaning: signed radial extent of a segment
peak EMF constant of harmonic n per mechanical rad/s

equations.source_notes: D08 eq. 3.6-3.14; D09 eq. 5-11; D07 p.3; exactness for in-plane conductors derived by Agent 2

tolerance.value: 1e-4 relative vs closed form; +/-8 % vs D08 measured Ke (O1); +/-5 % vs D09 calc/FEA (O2, once turns known)
tolerance.basis: numerical integration; D08 p.98 reports max 8 % model deviation

equations.name: Phase assembly, per-layer EMF, parallel paths and circulating loss
equations.formula: E_ph = sum_groups E_grp; E_grp = sum_i(E_i/R_i)/sum_i(1/R_i); R_grp = 1/sum_i(1/R_i); P_c = sum_i |E_i - E_grp|^2/(2*R_i) (peak phasors)
equations.source_notes: reduces to D01 eq. 2 for two members (R_c = 0); conflict with D15 equal-flux assumption (G3)

tolerance.basis: algebra; physical accuracy depends on per-layer field (G3)

equations.name: Winding factor of concentrated (spiral) coils and phase assignment
equations.formula: alpha_k = p*theta_k; 60-degree belts A+, -C, B+, -A, C+, -B; k_d,n = |sum_{k in A} s_k*exp(j*n*alpha_k)|/N_A; k_p,n = |sin(n*p*sigma/2)|; k_w,n = k_d,n*k_p,n; feasibility Q/(m*t) integer, t = gcd(Q,p); spiral average k_p,avg,n = (1/N)*sum_t |sin(n*p*sigma_t/2)|
equations.source_notes: D04 eq. 1; D11 eq. 14; D12 eq. 1 (N_c/N_pm = m/(m+1)); D07 p.3; D15 eq. 6 (per-turn average); feasibility rule textbook not accessed (G24); integer phasor arithmetic required (Xcoil belt-edge bug)

tolerance.value: 1e-9 (exact arithmetic); pattern identical to published table

equations.name: EMF/torque constants and star/delta conversion
equations.formula: Ke_ph = |E1|/omega_m; star: Ke_LL = sqrt(3)*Ke_ph, I_ph = I_line; delta: Ke_LL = Ke_ph, I_ph = I_line/sqrt(3); T = (m/2)*Ke_ph*I_ph_peak = (m/sqrt(2))*Ke_ph*I_ph_rms; Kt_line = (m/sqrt(2))*Ke_ph (star), /sqrt(3) (delta); K_v = 1/Ke_LL; R_LL = 2*R_ph (star), 2*R_ph/3 (delta)

variables.meaning: peak phase EMF per mech rad/s

equations.source_notes: D08 eq. 3.14 p.36, Table 9.1 p.98; D06 eq. 2 p.3; fundamental only

tolerance.basis: definitions; compare synthesised waveform peak with measured peak voltages

equations.name: DC resistance with temperature
equations.formula: rho_T = rho_20*(1 + alpha_20*(T - 20)); R_ph = sum rho_T*L_i/(w_i*t_i) + sum R_via + R_links (+ parallel combination per EQ-07)
equations.source_notes: D08 eq. 3.37-3.38 p.45; D10 eq. 8; D15 eq. 10; constants IACS / IEC 28 via NBS Handbook 100 p.2-4 (EV-53, page re-check pending); PCB copper = IACS is an assumption (G6)

tolerance.value: +/-8 % vs measured DC resistance at known temperature
tolerance.basis: D10 measured +7.5 % over its simulation (p.8); D09 measured +2.9 % over calc (Tables 1/6)

reference_case.source: hand calculation (C3) and D08 Table 4.6 p.57

additional_cases.source: D08 Table 4.5 p.54 (50 degC), Table 4.6 p.57

equations.name: Via barrel resistance
equations.formula: A = pi*(2*r*t_p - t_p^2), r = drill/2; R_via = rho_T*l/A; n vias in parallel -> R/n
equations.source_notes: D05 eq. 3-6 p.6-8; barrel only, no pad spreading or crowding (G7)

equations.name: Eddy-current loss in traces
equations.formula: P = (sigma/24)*sum_n (n*omega_e)^2 * sum_seg L_seg*(Bz_n^2*w^3*t + Bt_n^2*w*t^3), B peak amplitudes
equations.source_notes: D03 eq. 2 / D14 eq. 3 adopted; D04 eq. 9 / D10 eq. 10 are 2x larger with peak B (valid only with RMS B) - G4 resolved by derivation (classical lamination formula)

tolerance.basis: assumption until Agent 4 runs the FEM (uniform-field and end effects)

equations.name: Skin depth
equations.formula: delta = 1/sqrt(pi*f*mu0*sigma)
equations.source_notes: D01 eq. 4; D03 strand rule delta/3 as warning threshold (assumption)

equations.name: Inductance - first estimate only
equations.formula: L_m = (3*mu0/(4*pi))*(N*k_w1)^2*(D_o^2 - D_i^2)/(p^2*delta'), delta' = 2*l_m + 2*g + t_s; alternative: Xcoil current-sheet model (radial conductors only)
equations.source_notes: D10 eq. 14 p.5 as printed (confirmed by two derivations; error in eq. 12 of D10/D15; D15 eq. 14 pi/2 too large); G1 stays unresolved (no end-turn/leakage/sub-harmonic terms, no multi-layer spiral oracle)

tolerance.value: none claimed; target +/-20 % vs LCR measurement after validation

dominant_assumptions: omission of end-turn and leakage terms

reference_case.source: checks/c9_reference_values.js (example) and D09 Table 6 p.7 (oracle, turns unknown)

equations.name: IPC-2221 current capacity (guideline)
equations.formula: I = k*dT^0.44*A^0.725, A in mil^2, k = 0.048 external / 0.024 internal
equations.source_notes: IPC-2221 itself not in the corpus (G5); corpus cites it only for spacing

equations.name: Mass
equations.formula: m_Cu = rho_Cu*sum_L A_Cu,L*t_L; m_lam = rho_lam*(A_board*t_board - V_Cu)
equations.source_notes: copper density IACS (NBS Handbook 100 p.4); laminate density needs a datasheet source

inputs.copper: 6 layers x 50 % of r 18-38 mm annulus x 34.8 um

equations.name: First-order thermal estimate
equations.formula: dT = P_loss/(h*2*A_board) (engine); lumped alternative D01 eq. 6-8: theta = L/(K*A_c), dT_cond = P*theta, dT_conv = P/(h_t*A_PCB)
equations.source_notes: D01 h_t = 10 W/m2K 'widely used'; engine default 30 unsourced; D08 network eq. 7.1-7.5

tolerance.basis: assumption; h uncertain by x3 between sources

equations.name: EMF waveform and THD
equations.formula: E(theta_e) = sum_n |E_n|*cos(n*theta_e + arg E_n); THD_ph = sqrt(sum_{n>1} Ke_n^2)/Ke_1; line EMF = difference of phase waveforms
equations.source_notes: Xcoil emfWaveform/lineWaveform; oracle D09 Table 7 p.8 (5.7 %, basis unresolved)

equations.name: Delta circulating current (triplen EMF)
equations.formula: I_circ,n = |sum_ph E_n|/R_loop; P = sum_n I_circ,n^2*R_loop/2 (peak)

variables.meaning: phase EMF phasor of harmonic n (peak)

equations.source_notes: Xcoil applyConnection; resistance-limited upper bound (zero-sequence inductance ignored)

equations.name: Torque-speed envelope (drive)
equations.formula: steady-state dq model with R_ph, L_s, Ke, inverter limit (SVPWM V_LL,rms = V_dc/sqrt(2); SPWM sqrt(3)*V_dc/(2*sqrt(2)); six-step sqrt(6)*V_dc/pi) and current limit
equations.source_notes: standard PMSM/inverter theory - textbook source needed; depends on EQ-14

equations.name: Copper-loss-budget current (design aid)
equations.formula: I_ph = sqrt((P_Cu/m)/R_ph)
equations.source_notes: D08 eq. 4.3 p.53; no Xcoil implementation -> new

equations.name: Current density
equations.formula: J = I_ph/(a*w*t)
equations.source_notes: definition; limits only as context (D16 30 A/mm2 FEA, D10 12 A/mm2 -> 110 degC)
